---
title: "🐛 Bug Horror Stories"
---

Every coder has a bug that haunts them. Add yours to the table below — keep it to
**one line**, the more painful the better.

::: {.callout-warning}
## ⚠️ Conflict zone
Everyone edits *this same file*, so you'll probably hit a **merge conflict** when you
try to push. That's intentional! Before you start, run `git pull` to grab the latest
version, add your row to the **bottom** of the table, and if a conflict still happens,
that's your chance to practise resolving it. 💪
:::
